interpretation_rule: a dt trend that persists under fixed eta_pen is a time-discretization residual; a trend that changes materially when eta_pen is held fixed is confounded by the Brinkman penalty timescale

verdict.rule: the coupled and the fixed-eta dt trends are compared on the same observables at matched physical times; a material difference (>25% of the larger ratio) marks the observable as confounded by the Brinkman penalty timescale, otherwise as a time-discretization residual; rows from interior-inadmissible seeds that were actually run here are labelled and excluded
